name: a sharp inbox panel names the manual grind
looks: The same inbox resolves sharp, a real-looking message list with an open draft being written by hand, held steady on a dark field. A small caption beneath it names exactly what's costing the hours.
build: The panel is a fixed DOM card (ui-tilt-card's held-panel mechanic); the caption fades/rises in beneath it after a short pause, one phrase inside it in the accent colour.
sound: A soft whoosh as the panel resolves into focus.
prompt: Resolve a blurred inbox sharp into a real-looking message list with an open draft held steady on a dark field, then fade in a short caption beneath it naming exactly what's costing the hours, one phrase in the accent colour.
